verdict.rationale: Requesty documents its own Load Balancing Policies, which distribute requests across multiple models by user-defined weights with sticky routing by trace_id or user_id. It also documents Latency-Based Routing that picks the fastest model from real-time performance data. However, balancing is described across models, not explicitly across providers, deployments or keys, and there is no cost-based routing. Missing for 10: cost-based load balancing, explicit balancing across provider deployments or API keys, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can load-balance traffic across providers, deployments, or keys by weight, latency, or cost

citations.quote: Load Balancing Policies distribute your requests across multiple models based on weights you define.
Requests with the same trace_id or user_id always go to the same model.
Latency-Based Routing automatically selects the fastest model for each request based on real-time performance data.
